dirty_flow: DIRTIES: a Vencimento edit or a Valor edit on any row (markPlanDirty), and a hand-edited prefill (planDirty: !matchesFormula). DOES NOT DIRTY: a Forma edit - methods carry positionally through regeneration (row i keeps methods[i], tail inherits the last known one), so blocking a regeneration over one would be pure friction. While dirty the rows are frozen and the muted 'Plano ajustado manualmente' line plus a 'Regerar plano' header button appear. Changing a header control, the itens total or the base date while dirty makes currentPlanKey != appliedPlanKey, which renders the amber bar 'Voce ajustou as parcelas manualmente. Aplicar [entrada + ]N x vai substituir as parcelas editadas.' with Aplicar and Manter parcelas. Aplicar and Regerar plano are the same handler: setPlanDirty(false) AND setAppliedPlanKey('') - the key reset is required, because a row edit alone leaves the key unchanged and the guard would otherwise find nothing to regenerate (mutation M19 proves it). Manter parcelas restores the four header inputs from the shape encoded in appliedPlanKey and re-stamps the key against the CURRENT total, so the bar dismisses and the rows survive. No extra state: planDirty + appliedPlanKey carry both branches.
round_trip: deriveWizardPrefill's M-prefix split and the verbatim installment row mapping are untouched; the inference only DESCRIBES the rows. inferPaymentPlanShape(totalCents, rows, fallbackAnchor) anchors on rows[0].dueDate, builds three ordered candidates - (1) {none, n}, (2) {pct, cleanPct, n-1} only when n>=2 and the pct has at most 2 decimals and reproduces the entrada to the cent, (3) {fix, rows[0].amountBrl, n-1} when n>=2 - regenerates each and compares dueDate and amountBrl field by field, excluding method. First exact match wins. A hand-edited plan matches nothing, so it returns candidate 3 (or 1 when n<2) with matchesFormula:false; the wizard seeds planDirty:true, keeps installmentRows byte for byte, seeds the header to a best-effort description rather than a lie, and shows 'Plano ajustado manualmente'. Proven end to end: 'round-trips a hand-edited plan through save without rewriting it' asserts the submitted installments are exactly [2026-07-10 200000 pix, 2026-08-10 50000 boleto, 2026-11-30 50000 boleto] including the 2026-11-30 date no formula produces. False positives are impossible (matchesFormula only after a full compare); false negatives cost one extra muted line. A property test round-trips five generated shapes back to matchesFormula:true.

post_verify_amendment:
Gate 2 returned PASS with two non-blocking findings; both are closed here, in the same single amended commit (39103eb).

1) THE INVARIANT, and its Red. generateInstallmentPlan's docstring promised exactness for every input while the terminal .slice(0, MAX_PLAN_INSTALLMENTS) could drop the tail - and the tail is precisely the row carrying the floor remainder. With restanteCount 120 PLUS an entrada the plan generated 121 rows and lost the last one. Unreachable from the UI only because the ceiling lived in wizardPlanShape, i.e. in the caller rather than in the function making the promise - exactly the wrong place given the point of this slice was pure functions meant to be called directly. FIX: the ceiling moved INTO the pure layer. maxRemainingInstallments(entradaMode) is now exported from calculations.ts (120 with no entrada, 119 with one, keyed on the mode so the cap does not jump while the entrada value is still being typed) and restanteCountFor clamps against it, so the array can never exceed 120 and the .slice was deleted rather than kept as a guard. SalesOpsApp.tsx's local copy of the same rule was removed and it now imports the one definition, so the two cannot drift. RED FIRST: added 'stays exact and within the row cap when the restante count is at the ceiling', which calls the pure function directly over 4 totals x 4 entrada configs at restanteCount 120 and asserts both the exact sum and length <= 120. Against the committed code it failed with 'expected 99250000 to be 100000000' - R$ 7.500,00 vanished. Green after the fix. Mutation A1 (restanteCountFor ignores the entrada row) -> RED on that test. Mutation A2 (re-add the .slice) stays GREEN, which is not a test gap but the demonstration that the truncation is now provably dead code: the row count is bounded upstream, so nothing can reach the cap. A1 is what proves the ceiling carries the invariant.

2) THE SIXTH FALSE CLAUDE.md SENTENCE. My claim that inferPaymentPlanShape 'would read an API-generated uneven split as hand-edited' was wrong for the no-entrada case. I did not correct it from intent; I made it executable first. New test 'reads an API-shaped remainder-first plan the way CLAUDE.md documents' pins all three cases and passes: no-entrada API split [33334, 33333, 33333] at +0/+1/+2 infers {fix, 33334, 2} with matchesFormula TRUE (the fixed-entrada formula reproduces those rows to the cent, so it is neither hand-edited nor a false positive - just mislabelled); with-entrada [50000, 16668, 16666, 16666] infers matchesFormula FALSE, the safe outcome; and an evenly divisible split is byte-identical on both sides and infers as 'none' (positive control). I also reasoned out why the with-entrada branch is general rather than incidental: candidate 1 would need the remainder to be zero to align, and candidates 2 and 3 both place the remainder last, so any non-zero remainder mismatches. The CLAUDE.md paragraph now states exactly that, names which case gets which reading, says the second reading loses nothing but labels as an entrada what the API meant as an ordinary first parcela, and points at the test file so the prose cannot drift from the code again. Mutation A3 (drop the fixed candidate) -> RED on that test.

3) RECORD ONLY, not fixed, per instruction. A proposta whose receivables are ALL void - won, then cancel-contract, then revert to open - opens step 2 with an R$ 0,00 parcela where master auto-generated a full-total row. Cause: deriveWizardPrefill filters status 'void', so the row set is empty, inferPaymentPlanShape returns the single-parcela default with matchesFormula true, and appliedPlanKey is seeded from the prefill, so the regeneration guard sees no change to make on open. The operator recovers with one nudge of Parcelas restantes or a click of Regerar plano, the mismatch warning blocks Avancar meanwhile, and nothing invalid can be saved. Exotic and non-trapping, so deliberately left alone.

SCOPE HELD: the remainder-placement unification stays deferred, as the verifier ruled - closing it would mean editing apps/api/** or abandoning splitInstallmentsEqually, whose last-row remainder is pinned by a pre-existing master test. Gates re-run on the amended commit: lint=0 type-check=0 test=0 build=0, web 35 files / 320 tests, api and shared-utils unchanged, still exactly one commit on top of f9f869c.
